description: The City of Orange Beach, Alabama is a vibrant coastal community committed to providing excellent municipal services. The city government oversees planning and development, public safety, parks and recreation, water utilities, and community services. Orange Beach features beautiful beaches, parks, trails including the Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail system, and various recreational facilities. The city maintains high-performing schools, promotes economic development, and preserves the natural environment while sustaining tourism-based economy.
